# ElectronicBurstingNeuron

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A hardware-implemented neuron model that reproduces biological bursting behavior through coupled fast and slow dynamics, with explicit equations and circuit design. Brings biologically realistic temporal coding to in-network neuromorphic hardware, enhancing temporal pattern processing capabilities.
